reason: Before the fix, REGEX_FORMAT matches Y{1,4} but format() only implements YY/YYYY. Unsupported tokens Y and YYY fall through to timezone-offset fallback, producing offsets like '+0000' instead of literal 'Y' or '24Y'.
The fix changes REGEX_FORMAT to only match YYYY|YY and preserves unmatched tokens literally. Y becomes literal 'Y', YYY becomes 'YY'+'Y' (e.g., '24Y'), matching expected behavior.
PR is a refactor extracting tryDecodeURIComponent utility; the decoding logic (checking for '%' and calling decodeURIComponent) is unchanged. Percent-encoded route parameters still decode correctly.
Same refactor as js_0011; behavior is preserved. The new tryDecodeURIComponent utility handles '%' check internally, so percent-encoded params still decode.
PR description explicitly states the test 'Fails before the change and passes after.' Before fix, reschedule updates Redis but not @score, so in-memory entry.score/at return stale values.
Fix adds '@score = at.to_f' after zincrby, syncing in-memory score with Redis. The regression test asserts entry.score/at match new time within tolerance.
PR fixes Range header whitespace parsing; test checks Content-Type charset parsing. Unrelated code paths — existing charset parsing behavior unchanged.
Same as jvm_0007 — PR touches Range header parsing only; Content-Type charset handling unaffected.

Same PR as kbc_0007 (head revision); unrelated to archive timestamps. Behavior unchanged from base.
PR changes CredentialCache prefix path comparison (System.Net); test exercises JSON deserialization with nullable parent (System.Text.Json). Unrelated namespaces — no impact.
Same as kbc_0009 — PR and test are in different subsystems. JSON deserialization behavior unchanged.
PR fixes FETCH FIRST on empty WITH HOLD cursor; test checks INET subnet containment operator (<<= ANY). Unrelated SQL features — INET operator behavior unchanged.
Same PR as kbd_0013 (head revision); cursor fix doesn't affect INET comparison operators.
Before fix, NO_PROXY parsing treats all entries as domain names with wildcard prefix. IPv6 '::1' becomes invalid pattern 'all://*::1', causing client construction to fail.
Fix adds is_ipv6_hostname detection and formats IPv6 as 'all://[::1]'. Client constructs successfully with NO_PROXY=::1.
Before fix, Series.str.match raises for regex flags other than IGNORECASE (including DOTALL). The flag validation incorrectly rejects DOTALL even though it's a valid flag.
Fix restores support for flags like DOTALL, MULTILINE, VERBOSE, ASCII. Test explicitly checks DOTALL flag works for 'a.c' matching 'a\nc'.
PR description: 'bug when trying to freeze a chain that contains a group and more than 2 tasks after it'. Test serializes chain with group in middle — fails before fix.
Fix updates prepare_steps to correctly track prev_task/prev_res when tasks exist. Added regression test 'test_group_in_center_of_chain' that calls freeze() without raising.
Before fix, when '--' is first argument, parser enters trailing-values mode instead of honoring value_terminator. First positional captures everything, second gets nothing.
Fix checks if current positional has value_terminator matching '--' before entering trailing-values mode. Added test 'escape_as_value_terminator_with_empty_list' verifying correct handoff.
Before fix, late OSC11 response calls nvim_set_option_value('background',...) which triggers OptionSet autocmd after VimEnter. Test expects OptionSet NOT to fire (flaky failure).
Fix uses ':noautocmd set background=' to suppress OptionSet event. OSC11 response after VimEnter no longer triggers OptionSet/ColorScheme autocmds.
PR reorders @derive attribute reading to avoid compile-time dependency; test checks required field validation (changeset invalid when mandatory field blank). Unrelated — validation logic unchanged.
Same PR as sa_0007 (head revision); compile-time @derive change doesn't affect runtime required-field validation behavior.
